title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data

translated_title: 三思而后行：在世界模型中通过比较性想象进行探索与规划
translated_abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够在行动之前比较想象中的结果，但智能体仍需决定探索哪些备选方案，以及何时所提出的计划应当取代其已学习的策略。我们提出了SDI（想象中的同源分歧，Sibling Disagreement in Imagination），它通过一个共享的基于行动者的参考标准将这两项决策联系起来。SDI比较从同一模型状态想象出的动作序列，并利用行动者自身序列的重复展开来衡量固定行为下的变异性。该参考标准同时缩放候选回报之间的离散程度（提供探索信号）以及所提计划的预测优势（用于决定动作是否被接受）。当计划动作的优势超过参考变异性的固定倍数时，智能体执行该计划动作；否则，它遵循行动者的策略。SDI复用基础智能体的世界模型、行动者和评论家，无需额外的分歧集成模型。探索与规划共同引导训练数据的选择。
tldr: 提出SDI方法，利用基于行动者的共享参考标准，同时为世界模型中的探索信号和规划决策提供统一依据，使智能体能够自主判断执行计划动作还是遵循已学习的策略，且无需额外的分歧集成模型。
en_tdlr: SDI unifies exploration and planning in world models through a shared actor-based reference that scales both the spread of candidate returns and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, enabling the agent to decide whether to execute planned actions or follow its learned policy without requiring additional disagreement ensembles.
